title: Security Engineer (Senior/Lead) - MeshMesh
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.        The Experience  The MeshMesh Security Engineer safeguards the platform and its customers by building security into every layer of the system, from infrastructure to application code.   Responsibilities   Conduct security reviews and threat modeling for new features and systems.  Build and maintain security tooling, including vulnerability scanning and monitoring.  Partner with engineering teams to remediate vulnerabilities and harden systems.  Support compliance and audit efforts as the platform scales.  Own day-to-day security engineering execution, driving vulnerability remediation, security improvements, and continuous control validation.   Required Skills/Experience   You have 4-8 years of experience.  You have experience in application or infrastructure security engineering.  Experience with public cloud services (AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Azure)  2+ years of deep understanding of object oriented programming and experience with at least one object oriented programming language (Java, Go, Python C++, C#)  You have experience building large scale distributed systems, especially in cloud environments  You are familiar with common security frameworks and threat modeling practices.  You have experience with vulnerability scanning and remediation tooling.  You are an Agentic Engineer - you understand how to secure and review AI-assisted development workflows built with Claude and similar tools, including agent loops and tool use.   Preferred Skills/Experience   You hold a relevant security certification (e.g. CISSP, OSCP).  You have experience securing networking or IoT platforms.  You have hnowledge working with relational database MySQL, Postgres  You are familiar with open source technologies, such as ZooKeeper, MongoDB  You have experience building services with Docker and Kubernetes  You have good knowledge with network technologies, such as TCP/IP, DNS or load balancer  You are familiar with emerging AI security frameworks, such as OWASP LLM/Agentic Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS.  You have understanding of emerging security challenges and controls within AI-assisted and agentic software development lifecycles.   About Salesforce  Salesforce is the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI, Data, and CRM. We help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. We're committed to equality and creating a workplace that reflects the diversity of our communities and customers. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
